a meeting.
As your company president, I'm inspired by your
commitment to our team. I'm happy to announce that our
computer company has won the award for Tech Company
of the Year by our city's leading technology magazine. What
a great accomplishment! ® Management feels it is time
to expand our product line. As you know, some computer
companies produce mobile phones. Now, I'd like to open the
floor to your questions. Would anyone like to go first?
